source.Trigger: User asks which products need restocking
source.Inputs: Product inventory CSV; minimum stock threshold
source.Steps: Load inventory → compare current stock with minimum threshold → identify low-stock products → calculate reorder quantity → generate restock list
source.Decision_Logic: If current_stock < minimum_stock, mark product for restock
source.Expected_Output: List of products requiring restock with current stock, threshold, and suggested reorder quantity

steps.name: Compare threshold, identify low stock and calculate reorder quantities

source.Trigger: User asks to validate product prices
source.Steps: Load product prices → match products by SKU → compare internal and vendor prices → calculate percentage difference → flag exceptions
source.Expected_Output: Validation report showing matched products, price differences, and exceptions

steps.name: Match SKU, calculate percentage difference and flag exceptions

source.Trigger: User provides a vendor file for processing
source.Inputs: CSV/XLSX file containing vendor product data
source.Steps: Read file → detect columns → normalize column names → validate required fields → identify invalid rows → produce cleaned dataset
source.Decision_Logic: Rows missing SKU or product name are invalid
source.Expected_Output: Cleaned file plus validation summary and invalid-row report

steps.name: Validate fields and split invalid rows
Export cleaned dataset and invalid-row report

source.Trigger: User asks to generate product content
source.Inputs: Product name; category; attributes; material; color; target audience
source.Steps: Validate required attributes → create product description → generate short description → generate SEO title → generate meta description
source.Decision_Logic: Do not invent missing product attributes; explicitly mark missing information
source.Expected_Output: Product description, short description, SEO title, and meta description

steps.name: Validate attributes and record missing information
Generate description, short description, SEO title and meta

source.Trigger: User asks for an order status
source.Steps: Validate identifier → search order data → retrieve order status → retrieve shipment information → summarize current status
source.Decision_Logic: If no order is found, ask for another identifier
source.Expected_Output: Order status, items, shipment status, and tracking information when available

steps.name: Summarize order status, items and tracking

source.Trigger: User asks to find duplicate products
source.Steps: Load products → normalize names/SKUs → compare identifiers → compare product attributes → group likely duplicates → assign confidence
source.Decision_Logic: Exact SKU match is a definite duplicate; high attribute similarity is a possible duplicate
source.Expected_Output: Duplicate groups with matching fields and confidence level

steps.name: Compare identifiers and attributes, group duplicates and assign confidence

source.Trigger: User asks to create a campaign brief
source.Inputs: Campaign goal; product list; target audience; promotion; dates
source.Steps: Validate inputs → identify campaign objective → summarize products → create messaging → create channel recommendations → create campaign checklist
source.Decision_Logic: If campaign goal or dates are missing, request them before generating the brief
source.Expected_Output: Structured campaign brief with objective, audience, messaging, channels, timeline, and checklist

steps.name: Validate campaign goal and dates, summarize products
Create objective, messaging, channels, timeline and checklist

source.Trigger: User uploads or provides a keyword list
source.Steps: Read keywords → remove duplicates → classify search intent → map keywords to categories → identify high-priority keywords → export results
source.Decision_Logic: Classify each keyword as informational, commercial, transactional, or navigational
source.Expected_Output: Keyword report with intent, category, priority, and recommended target page

steps.name: Classify intent, map categories, prioritize and recommend target pages

source.Trigger: Manager asks the agent to assign a task
source.Inputs: Task description; employee list; skills; workload; priority; deadline
source.Steps: Understand task requirements → compare employee skills → check current workload → rank candidates → select employee → generate assignment summary
source.Decision_Logic: Prefer employees with required skills and available capacity; escalate if no suitable employee exists
source.Expected_Output: Recommended employee, reasoning, priority, deadline, and task summary

steps.name: Compare required skills, check capacity and rank candidates
Recommend employee or escalate; generate assignment summary

source.Trigger: User asks for a performance report
source.Steps: Load execution logs → calculate success/failure rate → calculate average execution time → identify frequent errors → identify slow steps → generate recommendations
source.Decision_Logic: Flag workflows with failure rate above 10% or average execution time above defined threshold
source.Expected_Output: Performance summary with metrics, problem areas, and improvement recommendations

steps.name: Calculate rates, execution times, errors and slow steps; flag problems
